user.title: Connect to EMASESA
user.description: Enter the credentials of your EMASESA Oficina Online account (the same ones you use at emasesaonline.com).

2fa.title: Verification code
2fa.description: EMASESA has sent a verification code (SMS or email) to confirm this new device. Enter it below — this is only needed once: this device will then be remembered as trusted.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect to EMASESA
reauth_confirm.description: EMASESA has stopped trusting this device and needs to verify it again. Enter your password to continue.

abort.already_configured: This EMASESA account is already configured.
